docs.title: Metal API Inventory
docs.desc: This is the Phase 1 inventory for MetalBridge. It compares the public Metal API surface in the macOS 26.2 SDK with the iOS 26.2 SDK using Xcode 26.3.

docs.title: Coverage Report
docs.desc: This report describes what MetalBridge implements, what it converts, what is only partially equivalent, and what cannot be provided on iOS. The runtime source of truth is Sources/MetalBridgeKit/Inventory/CompatibilityMan

docs.title: MetalBridge — Privacy Policy
docs.desc: MetalBridge is a from-scratch Swift iOS compatibility layer for public Metal APIs declared on macOS but not available on native iOS Metal. It targets Apple A9 and newer.
